_provenance: Raised by engine/watch.py on 2026-08-16: a headcount of 1,000 reported with nothing on file. Checking it against PitchBook profile 163154-17 (retrieved 2026-08-16) turned up something the headcount question did not ask about: Scale AI has a permanent CEO. Five outlets and the company's own newsroom carried the appointment of Francis deSouza; PitchBook still lists Jason Droege as interim at its 2026-08-10 update. The vendor lags the announcement, so the announcement wins. Separately, 43 of the 58 stories previously filed under this company were other companies raising money 'to scale AI' — corrected in the same pass.

ceo.value: Francis deSouza (appointed CEO 2026-08; previously a Google Cloud executive)
ceo.source: Scale AI newsroom announcement, carried by five outlets 2026-08-13 to 2026-08-16
ceo.note: Succeeds Jason Droege, who had been interim CEO and Chief Strategy Officer since Alexandr Wang's departure to Meta. PitchBook still showed the interim arrangement at its 2026-08-10 update. A permanent chief executive after a long interim period is a governance input, not just a personnel note.

prior_ceo.value: Jason Droege, Interim CEO and Chief Strategy Officer

site_band.source: Scale AI newsroom page, employees band
site_band.note: The company's own page shows a rounded band rather than a count. Recorded so the figure is on the record as considered, not adopted: a band cannot be compared with a dated count.

secondary.value: Outlander VC, Kindling Capital, Justin Kan and 10 other investors sold their stakes to Meta Platforms and Golden Falcon Capital; date undisclosed
secondary.source: PitchBook deal 314132-86T (Secondary Transaction - Private, Completed) and financing note dated 2026-07-31
secondary.note: Completed, but with no disclosed date or price, so it sets no mark. It does move ownership further toward Meta.

pb_revenue_ttm_bn.source: PitchBook Revenue field, fiscal period TTM 4Q2026
pb_revenue_ttm_bn.note: House ruling R3: a forward-window projection, not a run-rate.

value.condition: New CEO's first strategic move: Scale AI's revenue concentration shifted after Meta took a stake and its largest AI-lab customers began insourcing labelling
First valuation mark since June 2025: the $29B is fourteen months old and predates both the Meta stake and the leadership change
